experiment: Experiment 82.3.2 DA-SRPE — Decision-Aligned Safe Residual Prompt Evidence Learning
selection: Historical val=test. Strict test ACC improvement. Keep earliest tie.
preprocessing: Historical pre-CV RFE and scaling, transductive graph, train/test arrays unchanged.

class_statistics.estimation: Initialize with byte-exact E82.3 fit on legal E61 epoch10 training rows; explicit post-evaluation EMA follows below.

preflight.llr_no_discrimination: Block if raw and bounded per-direction and direction-mean training ROC-AUC are all exactly chance within 1e-12, or any required evidence is nonfinite. No held-out labels used.
preflight.gradient_scale_scope: Measure 0.001 × alignment KL, 0.001 × actual residual, and historical classification separately. Prompt and spectral classification gradients are exactly zero at gamma=0. Verify nonzero classification gradients again after one genuine joint update.

decision.performance: Per group, all audits pass, 10-fold paired ACC > 0 pp, BA >= 0 pp, SEN >= -0.5 pp, Prob-AUC >= -0.1 pp, and positive patient net corrections versus B0.
decision.mechanism: Per group, Residual-off on Best causes at least one net lost correct prediction and lower fold-mean ACC; test mean L1(w_sem,w_sp) and maximum absolute realized gate exceed the numerical identity tolerance.
decision.medical_semantics: Supporting evidence requires G2 vs G1 positive paired ACC and net correct patients, and replacing medical Query by anonymous in G2 gives lower paired ACC and negative net corrections.
decision.go: At least one group meets both performance and mechanism. Report the qualifying groups and whether independent medical Query evidence is established. Otherwise NO-GO.

ema.compute: CPU float64 legal CAM projection using the original spectrum cache, then observed first and uncentered second moments.
ema.initialization: Start with E82.3 mean and stable inference variance exactly. Derive raw second moment from E82.3 unbiased variance times (n-1)/n plus squared mean.
ema.variance: Clamp roundoff in second minus mean squared at zero and apply n/(n-1) by class before E82.3 stabilization. Inference uses float32.
ema.order: Train, four optimizer steps, evaluate once and select Best with prior EMA, freeze Best if selected, update EMA once using captured legal eval CAM, persist post-update Latest.

direction_selection.score: E82.3 scores from pre-gate normalized coverage and bounded Gaussian LLR.
direction_selection.weights: Normalize coverage times class-specific softplus of signed bounded LLR per class, then mix with softmax class scores.

gradient_diagnostics.scope: Per epoch on the shared 6081-parameter branch Prompt tensors only (excluding spectral tensors), using two autograd.grad calls on the existing training graph before the normal backward.
gradient_diagnostics.long_term_summary: Report all epochs and final quartile by fold. A negative cosine indicates opposing components on the shared Prompt parameters.
gradient_diagnostics.undefined: Cosine and norm ratio are null when their denominator vanishes. In particular, gamma starts at exactly zero.

alignment_target.description: Existing true-class logp margin Jacobian at enhanced CAM144, projected onto the unenhanced patient spectral components. Stop gradient through contributions and through CAM on the auxiliary selector. Balance KL by class.

patient_gate.input: Normalized CAM144, 16 × (w_sem − w_sp), detached beta, mean null attention.
patient_gate.semantic_off: Use w_sp in residual, substitute w_sp for w_sem and zero for beta and null gate inputs.

checkpoint_and_workers: Ten independent single-threaded worker processes, each sequentially running its fold G1 then G2 from separate fresh historical state. Latest commits every 10 epochs and at termination.
